_about: Words for the slice HUD (VS-11): hack panel, boss bar, radio bark box, location card, Continue screen and the slice pause menu. Hack names come from data/combat/hacks.json. Layout and timing: data/ui/slice_ui.json.

prompt._about: What the hack button says while something else is offered (CombatDirector.hack_prompt, keyed by its text_key). {button} is the live button name.
